alerts.title: Limited Parking at Bus Depot and Backcountry Information Center
alerts.description: Limited parking is expected at the Denali Bus Depot and Backcountry Information Center in 2027 due to a planned paving project. Visitors with departures from the Denali Bus Depot should allow extra time to arrive before scheduled bus departures.

alerts.title: Paving in Riley Creek Campground
alerts.description: Riley Creek Campground will have limited availability throughout the summer of 2027 due to a planned paving project. Campers should expect daytime activity, including noise. Check back in this space for more details as summer approaches.

alerts.title: Road Open To: Mile 3 (Park Headquarters)
alerts.description: The Denali Park Road is currently open to Mile 3, Park Headquarters. Snowy conditions beyond that point prevent vehicle travel, though pedestrian travel is permitted.
